verdict.rationale: An agent can define products and plans with pricing in `autumn.config.ts` and push them with `atmn push --yes`, or use the MCP server's plan-management tools; `atmn api` can call any public endpoint, and `attach` attaches plans to customers. However, no evidence shows a payment-link or checkout-URL endpoint, and there is no documented API-level create-product/price call. Missing for 10: an explicit API endpoint for creating products/prices, payment-link or checkout-URL generation, a documented end-to-end single-session agent flow, and hands-on corroboration.
